home.heroTitle: The Visual-First React Framework for High-Converting Experiences
home.heroSummary: Design, build, and ship web storefronts and portfolios with 100% atomic editable components, auto-balancing layouts, and instant dual-mode aesthetics. Built in collaboration with FIVORA Cloud.
home.introTitle: Engineered for visual perfection and effortless editing
home.introBody: Every editable value comes directly from structured site data with auto-balancing layouts, responsive typography, and strict contract validation out of the box.
home.featuresHeading: Why build with the DENEB-UI Authoring Kit?

features.title: 100% Atomic DENEB Components
features.body: Pre-built, accessible, high-converting components with responsive design token integration and zero runtime overhead.

features.title: Strict Visual Editing
features.body: Direct bidirectional field bindings enable instant visual customization in the Lab and on the FIVORA platform without breaking styles.

features.title: Instant Dual-Mode Aesthetics
features.body: Seamless light and dark mode out-of-the-box with intelligent token contrast calculations for typography and surfaces.

features.title: FIVORA Cloud Collaboration
features.body: Built-in integration for collaborative editing, marketplace publishing, and automated zero-dependency clean packaging.

home.productsSummary: Explore high-converting storefronts, portals, and templates engineered with DENEB-UI and verified for production.

about.heading: Empowering Developers to Build Visually Editable Web Experiences
about.body: DENEB UI was created by Chamika Gayashan & Induranga Kawishwara to bridge the gap between developer-grade React code and effortless visual editing. In collaboration with the FIVORA platform, we empower creators to ship ultra-fast static web applications while giving non-technical teams an intuitive live visual editor.
about.collageDescription: A visual tour of our architecture, design system engineering, and cloud deployment pipeline.
about.history: We believe modern web developers shouldn't have to choose between code elegance and visual customization. DENEB-UI provides atomic, contract-bound components that compile to lean Next.js static exports, backed by FIVORA Cloud for instant real-time publishing.
